'''Actuating modules''' were crucial components of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Once [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] had been energized by the weapon's [[XCiter/Legends|Xciter]],<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> it entered the actuating module and was then released as an intense beam of energy particles and light. The beam then passed into the [[prismatic crystal housing]] to be focused.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Improved actuating modules existed for [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] that increased the power and penetration of the weapon's shots. These improved modules contained updated firmware and stronger [[electromagnetic accelerator]]s, but the increased power they provided often caused weapons equipped with the modules to wear down and develop faults quickly. The upgrade was favored by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], along with anyone who wanted to make the first shot they got in count for more. The modules generally sold for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and models available during the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] included [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[X440 blaster actuating module]], [[Dolmax/Legends|Dolmax's]] [[Heavy blaster actuator]] and [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]' [[97R enhanced blaster actuating module]].<ref name="EOTEC" />
